label: Echo (demo engine)
description: A tiny built-in engine that proves AgentCanvas can run a workflow on more than one framework. It runs simple flows (set values, paths, wait for all, approvals, questions, Python steps); AI steps answer with scripted replies or repeat their prompt. Not for production.

notes.core.wait: a Wait step needs saved checkpoints that a scheduler can wake days later: run this workflow on LangGraph (Framework in the workflow settings)
notes.core.llm: answers with the scripted reply for its AI model, or repeats its prompt
notes.model.chat: only names the scripted replies; no model is called
